Does my voice leave my Mac?

Speech recognition runs locally. After the initial model download, dictation works offline. Voco does not save audio. Optional recent transcripts stay in memory until you quit.

narrative.overview: An oversized editorial opening leads to a working text destination with orange voice traces. Spacious reading chapters alternate with a real recorded interface preview and inspectable screenshots. A maker statement and giant closing wordmark keep the ending personal. Scoped to website/; root design files belong to the desktop app.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas, soft-white type, orange voice accents
Editorial whitespace alternating with large product scenes
Complete-transcript simulation and disclosed recorded interface evidence
Local privacy, honest setup constraints, and maker-led closing

rules.name: Evidence before claims
rules.body: Distinguish the illustrative browser demo from the real interface preview; identify sample data and inactive native dictation.

rules.name: Selective depth
rules.body: Use shadows for the destination, control pill, and recording; keep reading sections and screenshot surrounds tonal.

rules.name: Progressive motion
rules.body: Scroll lighting and theater travel enhance readable static content. Respect reduced motion and visibility.

dos: Do preserve full-transcript insertion, cancellation, and sample switching.
Do preserve keyboard navigation, visible focus, native video controls, captions, and native disclosures.
Do show offline-after-setup privacy, memory-only optional recent transcripts, and the independent maker.
Do retain working static downloads with Apple Silicon, macOS 26+, English, model setup, and notarization limitations.
donts: Do not reintroduce the removed Fn sculpture.
Do not imply live browser dictation or active native speech capture in the recording.
Do not promise speed, accuracy, public source availability, or Apple notarization.
Do not apply the marketing system to desktop root design documents.
